You can sign up for one, several or all ReModel cycles. Each cycle focuses on one open simulation model and includes two linked sessions: **Running** and **Reusing**. Registration for a cycle covers both sessions in that cycle.

## Cycle 1: Non-Elective Flow Simulation

- **Running the model:** 30 September 2026
- **Reusing the model:** 28 October 2026

[Sign up for Cycle 1]({{< var registration_forms.cycle_1 >}}){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

## Cycle 2: Meeting the demand of NHS 111 for primary care services

- **Running the model:** 25 November 2026
- **Reusing the model:** 6 January 2027

[Sign up for Cycle 2]({{< var registration_forms.cycle_2 >}}){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

## Cycle 3: The Value of Triage during Periods of Intense COVID-19 Demand

- **Running the model:** 27 January 2027
- **Reusing the model:** 24 February 2027

[Sign up for Cycle 3]({{< var registration_forms.cycle_3 >}}){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
